description: Wawona Runtime WASI packages (Mode A). Not jailbreak APT.

packages.name: hello-wasi
packages.summary: Tiny WASI P1 hello (smoke test for wpm; default prints hello)
packages.long_description: Minimal WASI Preview 1 CLI used to smoke-test wpm install, search, and wasm <name>. Default invocation prints hello to stdout. Not a Wayland client.

packages.name: hello-wasi-gui
packages.summary: Hello window over wl_shm + xdg (WASI P1 Wayland smoke)
packages.long_description: Companion to hello-wasi: same smoke role, but paints one Hello from WASI frame over wl_shm + xdg_wm_base. Connects via Wawona host imports, binds compositor / shm / xdg, handles configure and close. Not the interactive wayland-shm-demo (no seat, checkbox, or typing).

packages.name: wayland-shm-demo
packages.summary: Minimal wl_shm + xdg rectangle client for Wawona Runtime
packages.long_description: Real Wayland client for Wawona Runtime: wl_compositor + xdg_wm_base + wl_shm. The published blob is the Rust build (bitmap text, resize, pointer, checkbox, keyboard via wl_seat). Host ABI is unix connect plus SCM_RIGHTS. Prefer weston-simple-shm when a native port is available.
